source_review.method: Read extracted text and visually inspected all three 300 dpi PDF pages; confirmed printed identity, every main-text figure/table, all four 300 dpi full-graphic crops, numeric conditions and reported kinetic values. Crop bounds were reviewed to include the entire graphic and caption without adjacent prose. Conclusions distinguish in-vitro model-substrate results from the proposed in-vivo gatekeeper model.

verified_claims.evidence: Printed title, all five authors, journal, and DOI 10.1021/bi9009049 match the saved Zotero record.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.2 Figure 2 caption and chromatogram
verified_claims.evidence: 15 μM Zea TE, 5 mM substrate 6, 30 min, 50 mM phosphate pH 7.4 at 23 °C; product 7 is shown, linear acid 8 is not detected, and the caption reports no activity without enzyme.
kcat/KM is reported as (2.92 ± 0.16) × 10^3 M−1 s−1; solubility prevented separate determination of kcat and KM.
S163A and H332A showed no detectable catalytic activity; this supports residue importance without proving each chemical role.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.2 Figure 3 caption and chromatograms
verified_claims.evidence: A shows standards; B and C show aniline and butanol reactions with 5 μM enzyme, 10 mM 9, and 20 mM nucleophile for 3 h; negative controls lack detectable products.
At 0.1 μM enzyme and 1 mM 9, relative rates include butanol 1.00, benzyl alcohol 0.84, aniline 0.58, ethanol 0.50, and water 0.20 at 55 M.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.2 right column; SI availability statement p.3
verified_claims.evidence: Butanol kinetics are reported as kcat/KM (12.2 ± 1.6) × 10^3, kcat 9.8 ± 0.6 s−1, KM 0.80 ± 0.09 mM; parallel Lineweaver–Burk plots are described as consistent with ping-pong bi-bi.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.2 right column and p.3 left column
verified_claims.evidence: Hydrolysis of substrate 9 is reported as (16.0 ± 1.7) × 10^3 M−1 s−1; the α-methyl-β-ketopentanoate surrogate is reported at (0.088 ± 0.023) × 10^3 M−1 s−1.
Authors state that more native-like substrates are needed to rigorously test the proposal and frame iterative-cycle control as a possible model.
